subtopics.label: Heat-Related Illness and Climate Health Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on the health impacts of extreme heat events, including heat stroke, heat exhaustion, cardiovascular and sleep effects, and community-based or educational interventions to prevent and manage heat-related illness.
subtopics.short_description: Health impacts of extreme heat events and community-based strategies to prevent heat stroke, exhaustion, and cardiovascular effects.

subtopics.label: Hurricane and Natural Disaster Impacts on Health
subtopics.description: Studies examining the short- and long-term health consequences of hurricanes and extreme weather events, including cardiovascular disease, mortality, and health outcomes in vulnerable populations such as nursing home residents and Medicare beneficiaries.
subtopics.short_description: Short- and long-term health consequences of hurricanes and extreme weather in vulnerable populations.

subtopics.label: Air Pollution and Respiratory Health
subtopics.description: Research on the effects of ambient and indoor air pollutants—including NO2, PM2.5, soybean dust, mold, and cooking fuels—on respiratory outcomes such as asthma, hypersensitivity pneumonitis, and lung function.
subtopics.short_description: Effects of ambient and indoor air pollutants on asthma, lung function, and respiratory disease.

subtopics.label: Chemical and Toxic Substance Exposures
subtopics.description: Studies investigating health effects of exposure to toxic chemical elements, flame retardants, radon, fine particulate matter, and other environmental chemicals, including DNA damage, gene expression changes, and systemic toxicity.
subtopics.short_description: Health effects of flame retardants, radon, heavy metals, and fine particulates including DNA damage and systemic toxicity.

subtopics.label: Urban Microbiomes and Antimicrobial Resistance
subtopics.description: Research characterizing microbial communities and antimicrobial resistance genes in urban environments, including indoor dust, wastewater, and global metagenomic surveys of city microbiomes.
subtopics.short_description: Microbial communities and antimicrobial resistance genes in urban dust, wastewater, and global city environments.

subtopics.label: Built Environment and Urban Health Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies linking features of the urban built environment—including neighborhood design, food access, noise, and green space—to health outcomes such as cardiovascular disease, maternal mental health, and diet quality.
subtopics.short_description: Links between neighborhood design, green space, food access, and outcomes like cardiovascular disease and maternal mental health.

subtopics.label: Spaceflight Environmental Health and Physiology
subtopics.description: Research on the physiological and molecular health effects of spaceflight on astronauts, including cardiovascular changes, clonal hematopoiesis, genomic stability, telomere dynamics, and nutritional challenges in the space environment.
subtopics.short_description: Cardiovascular, genomic, and nutritional health effects of spaceflight on astronauts including telomere and hematopoietic changes.

subtopics.label: Epigenetic Aging and Early-Life Environmental Exposures
subtopics.description: Research using epigenetic clocks and molecular biomarkers to characterize how childhood and gestational environmental exposures accelerate or alter biological aging trajectories.
subtopics.short_description: Epigenetic clock-based assessment of how childhood and gestational exposures alter biological aging trajectories.

subtopics.label: Tobacco and E-Cigarette Exposure and Lung Pathology
subtopics.description: Studies examining the biological and clinical effects of cigarette smoke and electronic cigarette use on lung tissue, including lymphatic dysfunction, emphysema, oral epithelium changes, and smoking cessation behavior.
subtopics.short_description: Biological and clinical effects of cigarette and e-cigarette use on lung tissue, including emphysema and lymphatic dysfunction.

subtopics.label: Ambient Temperature and Cardiovascular Health
subtopics.description: Research on how ambient temperature extremes and climate-related exposures affect cardiovascular outcomes, including myocardial infarction severity, left ventricular function, and COVID-19 transmission dynamics.
subtopics.short_description: Effects of temperature extremes on myocardial infarction severity, left ventricular function, and climate-related cardiac outcomes.

subtopics.label: Occupational Exposures and Worker Health
subtopics.description: Studies on health risks and outcomes among workers in occupationally hazardous settings, including home health aides, healthcare workers, and surgical professionals, with attention to physical, mental, and ergonomic health impacts.
subtopics.short_description: Physical, mental, and ergonomic health risks among healthcare workers, home health aides, and other hazardous-setting professionals.

subtopics.label: Lead and Heavy Metal Exposure in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
subtopics.description: Research on environmental heavy metal exposures—particularly lead—in low- and middle-income country settings and their associations with cardiovascular and systemic health outcomes.
subtopics.display_name: Lead & Heavy Metal Exposure in LMICs
subtopics.short_description: Cardiovascular and systemic health effects of lead and heavy metal exposures in low- and middle-income country settings.

subtopics.label: Vector Control, Water, and Sanitation-Related Health
subtopics.description: Studies on environmental determinants of infectious disease burden including mosquito vector resistance, waterborne diarrheal disease in children, and solar lighting interventions affecting health in low-resource settings.
subtopics.short_description: Mosquito resistance, waterborne diarrheal disease in children, and sanitation interventions in low-resource settings.

subtopics.label: Disaster Exposure, PASC, and Environmental Risk Factors for Respiratory and Post-Acute Disease
subtopics.description: Research on long-term respiratory and post-acute health sequelae following major environmental disaster exposures, including 9/11 World Trade Center dust exposure and environmental risk factors for post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2.
subtopics.short_description: Long-term respiratory and post-acute disease following 9/11 dust exposure and environmental risk factors for post-acute COVID-19.
